---
title: "Mera Hussain Kazmi Brothers"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Raza"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Jo Naz-e-Zahra Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Mera Hussain, Mera Hussain.

1
Dein Jis Se Zindah Hai Woh Hai Hussain.

2
Iss Ki Riza Kibriya Ki Riza.
Rahib Ko Ba Izn-e-Rab-e-Olla.
Jo Betay Deta Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Kaba Yeh Sajdoon Se Bola Ruko.
Main Sab Ka Qibla Hoon Lekin Suno.
Jo Mera Qibla Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Khaliq Ko Pyari Hai Iss Ki Khushi.
Mimber Bana Le Jo Pusht-e-Nabi.
Sajday Barhata Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Par Le Ke Fitrus Yeh Keh Ke Ura.
Jo Hai Farishton Ka Mushkil Kusha.
Qismat Jo Likhta Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Aisi Khatabat Kabhi Na Suni.
Nook-e-Sina Ki Bulandi Se Bhi.
Rab Jis Ko Sunta Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Zahra Ka Beta Hai Sab Se Kareem.
Khaliq Ki Tarha Ghafoor Ur Raheem.
Hur Yeh Batata Hai Woh Hai Hussain.
Dawa Sukhan Ka Kiya Na Kabhi.
Apna Aqeeda Raza Hai Yehi.
Jo Shair Deta Hai Woh Hai Hussain.

اس کی رضا کبریا کی رضا
راہب کو بہ اذنِ ربِ اعلیٰ
جو بیٹے دیتا ہے وہ ہے حسین

import re

def sentence_case(line):
    line = re.sub(r\"[A-Za-z]+\", lambda match: match[0].capitalize() if match.start() == 0 or match[0].lower() in proper else match[0].lower(), line.removesuffix(\".\"))
    return line.replace(\"Apna aqeeda raza\", \"Apna aqeeda Raza\").replace(\"rab-e-Olla\", \"Rab-e-Olla\")

roman_block = \"\\n\".join(\"  \" + sentence_case(line) if line else \"\" for line in roman)

assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_block.split(\"\\n\\n\")] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in urdu.split(\"\\n\\n\")] == [2, 2, 22]
path.write_text(f\"---\\n{metadata}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_block}\\n---\\n\\n{urdu}\\n\")

item.text:
Reconstructed all 24 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the opening and both numbered stanzas align verse for verse. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Rab-e-Olla” as `ربِ اعلیٰ` and “Shair” as `شعر`. Only the [selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/58c00e6acad3451a98f5ad9625c56403/src/data/lyrics/mera-hussain-kazmi-brothers-tajpoints-d86c63f796fbbd4ed5d4.md) was edited.
